title: Hepatic ChREBP reciprocally modulates systemic insulin sensitivity in NAFLD.
authors: Sen, Aniket; Thakur, Shilpa; Rawat, Priya; Jaswal, Kajal; Dehury, Budheswar; Mondal, Prosenjit
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝脏ChREBP调控胰岛素敏感性，虽含分子动力学模拟发现小分子槲皮素，但核心是代谢信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The relation between hepatic ChREBP level and insulin sensitivity remains equivocal. Our study, however, provides compelling evidence that hepatic ChREBP depletion can significantly enhance insulin sensitivity in high-fat and sucrose-fed mice. We have identified that transcriptional induction of hepatic PTEN is driven by ChREBP. Mechanistically, two critical stimuli are elicited in the hepatic ChREBP knockdown condition. The PTEN level is reduced for one stimulus, thereby promoting hepatic insulin sensitivity. The second stimulus, where reduced hepatic PTEN leads to the enhanced release of FGF21, spreads systemic insulin sensitivity. These findings identify hepatic ChREBP as a critical modulator of systemic insulin signaling and suggest that ChREBP downregulation may lead to protection against insulin resistance. Building on this, our molecular dynamics simulation analysis has led to the discovery of a small molecule, Quercetin, that sequesters ChREBP in the cytosol. We report that Quercetin treatment can sequester ChREBP in the cytosol and abrogate high-fat and sucrose-fed-mediated ChREBP nuclear translocation, thereby mimicking the insulin-sensitizing abilities of the hepatic ChREBP knockdown condition. These findings have significant therapeutic implications, suggesting that liver-selective downregulation of ChREBP could protect against systemic insulin resistance that frequently develops early in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and T2DM.
abstract_zh: 肝脏ChREBP水平与胰岛素敏感性之间的关系仍不明确。然而，我们的研究提供了有力证据，表明肝脏ChREBP耗竭可显著增强高脂和蔗糖喂养小鼠的胰岛素敏感性。我们已确定，肝脏PTEN的转录诱导由ChREBP驱动。在机制上，肝脏ChREBP敲低条件下引发了两种关键刺激。一种刺激是PTEN水平降低，从而促进肝脏胰岛素敏感性。第二种刺激是，肝脏PTEN减少导致FGF21释放增强，从而扩散全身性胰岛素敏感性。这些发现将肝脏ChREBP识别为全身性胰岛素信号传导的关键调节因子，并提示ChREBP下调可能对胰岛素抵抗具有保护作用。在此基础上，我们的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟分析发现了一种小分子——槲皮素 (Quercetin)，它能将ChREBP隔离在细胞质中。我们报告，槲皮素处理可将ChREBP隔离在细胞质中，并消除高脂和蔗糖喂养介导的ChREBP核转位，从而模拟肝脏ChREBP敲低条件下的胰岛素增敏能力。这些发现具有重要的治疗意义，提示肝脏选择性下调ChREBP可预防在NAFLD和T2DM发病早期常出现的全身性胰岛素抵抗。
